title: US-Iran Islamabad MOU's 60-Day Window Expires Without Final Agreement
detail: August 17, 2026 — The 60-day negotiating window established by the June 17 Pakistan-brokered Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding expired without a comprehensive US-Iran agreement. The MOU's vague wording over who controls Strait of Hormuz shipping proved a central sticking point — Iran struck several vessels it said failed to follow its approved transit route — and no sign emerged that detailed nuclear talks had even begun. Iran's Foreign Ministry disputed that a hard 60-day deadline existed at all, saying Tehran 'will not set policy under time pressure,' while Washington and Tehran offered conflicting interpretations of what the June accord actually committed them to. The impasse follows an Aug 11 dispute over dueling compensation demands — Trump seeking damages for alleged decades of Iranian actions, Iran demanding compensation for five months of US/Israeli strikes before it will fully reopen Hormuz. Any extension requires mutual consent; none was announced as the deadline lapsed.

title: Kushner, Netanyahu Agree US General Will Oversee Hamas Weapons Handover
detail: August 17, 2026 — After an hours-long Jerusalem meeting joined by US Ambassador Mike Huckabee and former UK PM Tony Blair, Jared Kushner and Prime Minister Netanyahu agreed that Gaza 'demilitarization' should begin with a Hamas weapons handover supervised by a US military officer, Maj. Gen. Jasper Jeffers, who heads the International Stabilization Force (ISF). Weapons surrendered by Hamas would be transferred to the proposed National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG) and the ISF. The meeting followed rare direct Board of Peace talks with Hamas leadership in Egypt, part of a renewed push to revive the roadmap Trump and Hamas have endorsed but which Netanyahu formally rejected Aug 9. Netanyahu maintained no IDF pullback would be approved before full disarmament of both light and heavy weapons, keeping the fundamental sequencing dispute — disarmament first vs. withdrawal first — unresolved even as the verification mechanism takes shape.
